sentences.text: Cetarthrosaurus was an extinct genus of ichthyosaur discovered in the eastern United Kingdom.
Harry G. Seeley named the genus Cetarthrosaurus in 1873, establishing Cetarthrosaurus walkeri as the type species.
Cetarthrosaurus belongs to the order Ichthyosauria.
It is classified within the unranked family Thunnosauria.
Fossils of this animal come from the Cambridge Greensand Formation, dating to the late Albian or early Cenomanian stages of the Early Cretaceous.
Cetarthrosaurus lived between 106.3 and 100.5 million years ago during the Albian stage.
